name: m5-backend-bound
description: How much would codegen writing straight to a `ClassWriter` save, before changing the compiler? `decode`, `decodeTree` and `replay` read the classfiles into nothing, a new `ClassNode` and a `ClassWriter`, so with `readFrames` they separate decoding, building the tree, walking it and the writer's own work. `replayBlocks` clears the reader's debug-only flag, so every label starts a basic block as codegen's do. `nestedClasses` is the walk behind `setInnerClasses`, which a direct path would have to replace. `phase`, `codegen` and `write` put those in proportion.
On [retronym/scala#200](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/200) at `b8c499db39`, which direct emission builds on, with the release optimizer settings; patched JDK 26, 8G heap.
